description: Higher-critic frozen-observation screens at fixed J6/N512/H3/B512 and three actor/temperature updates per round. Existing total-budget controls preserve the original three joint update slots and append only critic updates; no critic-first phase switch. Saved model, outer temperature, and environment come from the checkpoint.

critic_budget.description: Inner settings match named_run/d512_4_j6 except critic dose and the explicitly selected bootstrap source. Use saved prior observations for three repetitions per root. C3 controls are optional and never defaulted in.

inner_target_c3.description: J6/N512/H3/B512 with inner_target bootstraps. Each round runs three joint critic/actor/temperature slots, then 0 critic-only slots: 18/18/18 critic/actor/temperature updates per decision. Optional equivalence control; never selected by default.

inner_target_c6.description: J6/N512/H3/B512 with inner_target bootstraps. Each round runs three joint critic/actor/temperature slots, then 3 critic-only slots: 36/18/18 critic/actor/temperature updates per decision. Explicit higher-critic screen.

inner_target_c12.description: J6/N512/H3/B512 with inner_target bootstraps. Each round runs three joint critic/actor/temperature slots, then 9 critic-only slots: 72/18/18 critic/actor/temperature updates per decision. Explicit higher-critic screen.

outer_target_c3.description: J6/N512/H3/B512 with outer_target bootstraps. Each round runs three joint critic/actor/temperature slots, then 0 critic-only slots: 18/18/18 critic/actor/temperature updates per decision. Optional equivalence control; never selected by default.

outer_target_c6.description: J6/N512/H3/B512 with outer_target bootstraps. Each round runs three joint critic/actor/temperature slots, then 3 critic-only slots: 36/18/18 critic/actor/temperature updates per decision. Explicit higher-critic screen.

outer_target_c12.description: J6/N512/H3/B512 with outer_target bootstraps. Each round runs three joint critic/actor/temperature slots, then 9 critic-only slots: 72/18/18 critic/actor/temperature updates per decision. Explicit higher-critic screen.
